description: Get a fresh shareable download URL for a previously uploaded file. The file must be in READY status. Share this URL with anyone — it works without authentication. Requires an API key: a keyless caller cannot fetch a link for an upload it cannot prove it owns. Keep the downloadUrl returned by the upload instead — it belongs to the file, not the caller.

uploadId.description: Upload ID returned from upload_file or upload_from_url (e.g. up_a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8)

name: get_download_url

ready.description: True when the file is downloadable

title: Get Download URL
